item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. It's a packed day, back to back from morning check-ins through an evening catch-up, easy to let meals slide into whatever's fastest. Don't let a busy schedule turn into skipped or rushed eating. Build in one real pause today to eat without multitasking. Action: before your midday commitments, actually sit down and eat a proper meal.
